title: Why Metadata Matters for Findability
author: Meghana K.
summary: Titles, descriptions and tags help search engines and colleagues find the right content quickly.
image_alt: Illustration of tags and labels attached to documents
body: Metadata is information about content: title, summary, author, date, tags and status.
Consistent metadata lets teams search, filter and update many pages at once.
Pair this with {{writing-accessible-content}} to keep pages both findable and usable.
